outlook.statement: The Company proposes to venture into the energy sector to meet its growing internal power requirements through captive generation and to explore business opportunities in renewable and non-conventional energy sources, including solar and wind power.

The outlook for the pipe and polymer industry remains positive with government policies promoting infrastructure, irrigation, sanitation, and housing. The Company aims to expand its dealer/distribution network across India, introduce new product lines in value-added segments, enhance manufacturing efficiency through automation and process optimization, and invest in R&D for sustainable and innovative polymer solutions.
